tacoma-eye-care.brief: Build a homepage for Lena Ortiz, an independent optometrist in Tacoma. Lena sees new patients for routine eye exams and glasses fittings at 42 Example Way, Suite 2. Visitors can call 253-555-0143 between 9 am and 4 pm, Tuesday through Saturday. Make the right person, the two services and the call link easy to find. There is no portrait. Below the introduction, offer a short reminder people can prepare to have ready when they call. Let people choose Eye exam or Glasses fitting, enter a first name and preview their own editable reminder in the browser. No information leaves the page and nothing is booked. Show how to fix a blank name and retain the service choice when the user edits. Avoid photos, insurance claims, reviews, pricing or extra destinations.

direction.title: Direct consultation
direction.summary: Pair the named practice and person with the one verified way to start a conversation.

layout.skeleton: Lead with the named practitioner and the supplied contact action. If the visitor can prepare a short note for the call, make that form part of the same opening composition. Use the labeled visit choices as the service list. Keep extra headings, repeated descriptions and purely decorative elements below the controls.
layout.focus: The actual professional and how to reach them. Give their name and the primary contact path a clear position beside the portrait or its text alternative.
layout.desktop: Keep the supplied phone, hours and place together. On phones, put short call preparation immediately after those details with the first field and preview visible at 320 px in a 700 px viewport. Preserve explicit ordering and supplied portraits. Keep longer intake in its own section.
layout.mobile: At 390 px show the practice, location, named person and first contact action before a large portrait. Preserve section access with a compact keyboard menu if needed. At 320 px drop duplicated contact links before shrinking targets.
layout.rhythm: Use #172747 for a full-width introduction, #D7E1FA for supporting text in it and #52637E on the light reading area. Use thin rules and asymmetric spacing to separate service links from the intake area.

imagery.subject: The practitioner shown in a supplied portrait, with their name and supplied role.
imagery.crop: Crop for a readable face and clear space over the head. Verify the smallest width. Keep the portrait separate from text and use the image at its natural proportions.
imagery.fallback: Set the supplied name and practice as the signature. Use no stock stand-in for a real person and no invented license, result or testimonial.

motion.trigger: A visitor expands one service in the practice list.
motion.effect: Reveal the relevant text below the named control. Keep the control and its description in view after keyboard activation.
motion.reduced: Show the description without motion and retain focus at the same control.

action.instruction: When calling is the task, show the supplied number as a call link. Give any requested form a section action and announce its result. If the form previews a draft, label it as a draft and preserve the entries. Move focus to the draft so it is fully visible on activation without waiting for a scroll animation. Say a request was sent only if the form actually sends it.
action.label: Call or request a consultation

direction.why: A visitor choosing a professional service needs to know who can help and how to reach them. Putting the supplied identity and contact path together makes that decision possible before secondary details.

sources.observation: The firm identifies distinct phone numbers for prospective and existing clients. Each label tells the caller which path applies.
USWDS recommends including the country code in click-to-call destinations.

interaction.keyboard: Expose the primary control by keyboard and announce pending and completed states.

assumptions: Use only the project facts and assets in the brief.

dayton-physiotherapy.brief: Make a homepage for Morgan Reyes, an independent physical therapist in Dayton. Morgan handles post-surgery and running-injury rehabilitation at 25 Example Lane. The office answers 937-555-0127 from 8 am to 3 pm on weekdays. Show who answers, the phone and the hours first. Visitors can prepare a short, editable note for the call. Let them choose Knee rehabilitation or Running assessment, enter a first name and preview. Show a recovery for a missing name. Keep the draft on the page and send nothing. Avoid photos, outcome guarantees and pricing.

madison-counseling.brief: Build a homepage for Taylor Ibarra, an independent counselor in Madison. Adults can call Taylor at 608-555-0134 from 10 am to 5 pm, Monday through Thursday, at 37 Example Street. Show who answers, the call link, hours and location. Offer an optional short note to prepare for the call. Let visitors choose Individual counseling or Couples counseling, enter a first name and preview an editable note. Help a visitor recover when the first name is blank, and keep their choice and name when they go back. The note stays on the page. It sends nothing and books nothing. Avoid photos, prices, testimonials and treatment guarantees.
